#Recruitment
🏡 Sphere #Payments
🐇 Introduction:
https://spherepay.co/
The payments infrastructure paving the way for merchants.


🛵 #Full·Time #Remote
📚 #Senior·Software·Engineer (Customer Success) #Engineering
💰 Compensation: Negotiable

🌱 Responsibilities:
1️⃣ Build internal tooling, automations, and workflows that allow to identify patterns in support volume, reduce manual effort and make the team faster.
2️⃣ Own engineering support end-to-end. You’ll triage incoming issues, diagnose root causes, and resolve them, including writing and shipping code fixes directly when the problem warrants it.
3️⃣ Engage directly with customers in the context of support and communicate clearly on technical issues, timelines, and resolutions.
4️⃣ Partner with product and engineering to define work that makes the platform easier to support: better error messages, smarter observability, improved defaults. Quantify the impact and make the case for prioritization.
5️⃣ Work together with product, engineering towards a product roadmap aiming reducing the number of technical queries received by support.
6️⃣ Collaborate with customer support, onboarding and payment ops teams to ensure workarounds are documented and used by AI to faster customer support.
7️⃣ Own our customer facing documents, ensuring accuracy and usefulness so customers can unblock their own agency

🌵 Requirements:
1️⃣ Leveraged mindset. You are able to find the best solution for a given problem that balances expediency and future-proofing.
2️⃣ Strong programming fundamentals and comfort working across the stack. You can read production code, trace a bug through logs, and ship a fix without a lot of handholding.
3️⃣ Proficient in #TypeScript, #React and #NestJS.
4️⃣ Experience with API integrations, webhooks, and cloud platforms.
5️⃣ Excellent written communication. You can explain a technical issue precisely to a developer and clearly to a non-technical stakeholder, without losing accuracy in either direction.
6️⃣ Self-directed and high ownership. You can manage an open queue, triage by impact, and keep things moving asynchronously across time zones.
7️⃣ Familiarity with observability tooling (Sentry, structured logging, distributed tracing) is a plus.
8️⃣ Experience in fintech, payments, or developer-facing products is a plus.

#Recruitment
🏡 Bullbit #PERP #DEX
🐇 Introduction:
https://bullbit.ai/
A perp DEX built on Base, delivering an invisible blockchain experience with CEX-like speed and simplicity.


🛵 #Full·Time #Remote #Singapore
📚 #Business·Development·Lead (IB & Volume Growth)
#Marketing
💰 Compensation: Negotiable

🌱 Responsibilities:
1️⃣ Recruit, onboard, and manage a portfolio of Introducing Brokers (IBs) and affiliates, structuring commission/rev-share deals that are fee-positive for the platform
2️⃣ Identify and personally onboard high-net-worth traders and whales, negotiating VIP terms, fee tiers, and rebates
3️⃣ Build and scale relationships with trading communities and signal groups (Telegram/Discord trading groups, copy-trade communities, local trader networks), turning community leaders into de facto IBs who drive recurring group volume.
4️⃣ Own exchange-level KPIs: trading volume, open interest, maker/taker fee mix, liquidity depth, VIP tier structures, referral/rebate economics, using these numbers to drive partnership strategy and decisions
5️⃣ Structure and negotiate a range of deal types (rev-share, fixed rebate, hybrid, token-based, milestone-linked) and manage the full partnership lifecycle from outreach through long-term retention.
6️⃣ Build and manage the partner/IB pipeline (tracking, funnel stages, reporting), and set targets and structure for the BD team.
7️⃣ Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Finance to design referral programs, trading competitions, and IB incentive structures.
8️⃣ Represent Bullbit at local industry events, AMAs, and community engagements when needed

🌵 Requirements:
1️⃣ 3+ years of BD/growth experience in crypto exchanges, perp DEXs, forex, or CFD brokerage, specifically in IB/affiliate/volume-growth functions (not general partnerships)
2️⃣ Demonstrable track record: you can point to specific IBs recruited, traders onboarded, or volume you've directly driven at a previous platform
3️⃣ Existing network: real, activatable contacts among traders, IBs, or trading communities
4️⃣ Working fluency in exchange economics: maker/taker fees, rebate structures, VIP tiering, volume-based incentive design.
5️⃣ Strong negotiation instincts; comfortable structuring milestone-based deals and walking away from bad terms.
6️⃣ Experience managing or mentoring a small team, or clear readiness to do so
7️⃣ Professional English (written + spoken); Mandarin is a strong plus
💡 Nice to Have
1️⃣ Prior experience specifically with perpetual DEXs or derivatives products
2️⃣ Existing relationships with market makers, liquidity providers, or institutional trading desks
3️⃣ End-to-end IB program experience (recruitment → compensation design → performance tracking)
4️⃣ Familiarity with Base or other EVM-compatible ecosystems

📷 Apply:
Email: hr.admin@bullbit.ai
- Send your CV to hr.admin@bullbit.ai
- Subject line: Bullbit - BD Manager - Full Name
- Please include in your application (or cover note):
+ A brief summary of your existing IB/trader/community network (size, region, activity level).
+ Volume or revenue numbers you've personally driven at a previous role, if you can share
